claim: Actual rational-open arithmetic scheme map into the original full diamond-fixed algebra with exact base/global-j squares and full-domain original compact/marked-point comparison.

obligations.name: Actual source open and base scope
obligations.required_input: The moduli bridge must use the original projective parameter source and the exact old arithmetic base, without extending the integral model through3 or exceptional j fibers.
obligations.constructed_input: Ring is the localization of the original Laurent ring at jLaurent*(jLaurent-1728); its Spec embedding is the original Laurent inclusion followed by the original source projective embedding.
obligations.justification: The source range is exactly the corresponding basicOpen in the Laurent scheme. The construction is rational and retains all original excluded values; no full Z-model or elliptic-fiber extension of the old affine x chart is claimed.

obligations.name: Constructed arithmetic base change
obligations.required_input: A pointwise j formula does not define a family map without proving denominator invertibility.
obligations.constructed_input: The original source TS=1 identity proves j-1728=D(T)^2*S^3. Localizing makes j,j-1728 and D units. The actual localization lift defines baseMap from OpenJModel318.Base3 into Ring.
obligations.justification: The literal original elliptic family is mapped along this constructed baseMap, remains elliptic, and its genuine Weierstrass j equals the same source j. Rational inversion of18 is justified through the Q-algebra map; no inverse is assumed at characteristic3.

obligations.name: Original division equation in the source ring
obligations.required_input: The actual third-division algebra requires its defining polynomial to vanish inside the source ring, not merely at analytic points.
obligations.constructed_input: x=3(T+27)(T+243)/D and k=N(T)/D^2 satisfy x^4-6kx^2-8kx-3k^2=0 from D*v=1 and a polynomial identity. base_A/base_B identify the original family coefficients with -3k/-2k.
obligations.justification: The original division polynomial vanishes by this identity. Its exact scalar relation with the monic division polynomial, together with invertibility of3, proves the AdjoinRoot lift condition.

obligations.name: Actual diamond-fixed algebra consumer
obligations.required_input: A four-point count or arbitrary labeling does not identify the original primitive-three quotient.
obligations.constructed_input: xMap is the actual AdjoinRoot.lift into Ring. fixedMap is its composition with the inverse of the original ThreeTorsionSignQuotient318.signQuotientEquiv.
obligations.justification: The map consumes LiteralThreeXComparison318.Fixed3 unchanged and preserves its original base j and xGenerator exactly. This is the full original diamond-fixed algebra, not an unnamed isomorphic four-dimensional algebra.

obligations.name: Exact scheme morphism and j square
obligations.required_input: A coordinate map must induce a morphism of the actual schemes and agree with the global finite j morphism.
obligations.constructed_input: arithmeticMap is literal Spec.map fixedMap; arithmetic_base_square is equality with the actual base map. global_j_square identifies the projective embedding followed by ThreeProjectiveJMap318.map with rationalJ followed by original chart1.
obligations.justification: The global square uses the whole Laurent scheme square and equality of polynomial ring maps, not dense-open complex-point inference. The global proper/quasifinite finiteness theorem remains for the same original projective map.

obligations.name: All admissible evaluations and x marker
obligations.required_input: The new arithmetic map must agree with the old comparison at every point of its full domain, including the chosen actual marked-point coordinate.
obligations.constructed_input: evaluation is two successive localization lifts at every ParameterOpen point. Exact evaluations of T,S,j,D,v,x give J(T),X(T).
obligations.justification: ModularArithmeticCoordinates318.hom_ext uses both original j and x generators to identify evaluation composed with fixedMap with complexPoint3(sourceParameter3.symm T). This does not infer equality from matching j alone.

obligations.name: Whole-domain arithmetic point coverage
obligations.required_input: The comparison must neither omit branches nor replace source points with arbitrary labels.
obligations.constructed_input: arithmetic_evaluation_bijective composes the existing actual complexPoint injectivity/surjectivity with the explicitly inverse original sourceParameter.
obligations.justification: All points of the original fixed algebra over C are covered exactly once by the constructed arithmetic scheme map evaluations. This point theorem is not used as an unproved scheme-isomorphism criterion.

obligations.name: Compact analytic source and actual period compatibility
obligations.required_input: The moduli interface must consume the existing compact analytic comparison, not a fresh source with the same j invariant.
obligations.constructed_input: sourcePoint_compact identifies the constructed source scheme point with compactPointHomeomorph(original q). sourcePoint_arithmetic gives the original arithmetic schemePoint, and sourcePoint_period retains the actual fixedPoint from period1/3.

The sourceParameter restriction theorem retains original x and actual quotient points. sourcePoint_global_j then uses the same compact global j map; inherited full cusp/elliptic holomorphy and local-order results remain unchanged.
